items.docs:
Returns the calling user's identity, organization context, and permissions, read from the bearer token's claims.
Answers "who am I" and "which organization am I in"; it takes no user ID and cannot look anyone else up.

params.name: _page
params.description:
The page of results to return.
The first page is page number 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of results returned per page.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Sorts results according to the specified field.

params.name: _order
params.description: The sort order (ascending / descending) of the field specified by the `_sortBy` parameter.

params.name: _search
params.description:
A search filter that is applied to all fields.
Only results that contain the specified string are returned.

params.name: _include
params.description: Include additional information about related resources in the results.

params.name: _format
params.description: The format of returned results.
